newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil tip-toes higher with firmer IPE.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil tip-toes higher with firmer IPE.

text.p: NWE gas oil was a touch firmer on Monday on the back of narrowly stronger futures, but differentials were broadly unchanged in a slow market.
Front month August IPE gas oil closed at $172.25 a tonne, up 75 cents with a wavering screen crude market giving little to no direction.
Heating oil barges were talked around steady numbers for much of the day: +50 cents on the buyers' side and offers of $1.25, some as high as $1.50.
Trade was heard concluded on a Antwerp refinery barge at 50 cents fob, but stored Antwerp material seeking buyers at +$1.00 was not realistically going to get taken up, traders said.
EN590 was retaining its differential of around $4.00 against August IPE gas oil, but there was no talk of buying.
Traders said the Mediterranean market was starting to show signs of outpacing NWE since Russian material is becoming less well offered and Italy looks sold out until later in the month.
